targets.query: SELECT mean("netSnapshotCapacityInKb")  / 2 FROM "scaleio.storagepool" WHERE ("cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "protection_domain_name" =~ /^$domain$/ AND "storage_pool_name" =~ /^$pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

list.name: cluster
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "scaleio.cluster" WITH KEY = "cluster"

list.name: clusterid
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "scaleio.cluster" WITH KEY = "cluster_id"

list.name: domain
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "scaleio.protectiondomain.iops.read" WITH KEY = "protection_domain_name" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/

list.name: domainid
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "scaleio.protectiondomain.iops.read" WITH KEY = "protection_domain_id" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/

list.name: pool
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "scaleio.storagepool" WITH KEY = "storage_pool_name" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "protection_domain_name" =~ /^$domain$/

list.name: poolid
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "scaleio.storagepool" WITH KEY = "storage_pool_id" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "protection_domain_name" =~ /^$domain$/
